17:27 Local Time, 15:27 GMT, 20:57 IST: What a thriller! Namibia came agonisingly close to scripting a sensational comeback after a nightmare start to their chase. Step forward, Brad Evans, with 16 needed off the last over, he delivered under maximum pressure to take Zimbabwe over the line! That said, Zimbabwe will know they got away with one here. A brilliant 100-run partnership between Green and Volschenk flipped the game on its head, with Green's inventive boundary-hitting causing chaos in the field. A heroic effort from Namibia, but a serious reality check for Zimbabwe's bowling and fielding standards. Stick around, the presentation ceremony is coming right up!

Brad Evans (Player of the Match, 67 runs with the bat and 3/41 with the ball): [On taking his first Player of the Match award in international cricket] Yeah, pretty good. The man standing over there has stolen a few from me, but it's good to get over the line and secure a good win. [On the pressure of bowling the final over] I enjoy those moments. I had a simple plan and just tried to execute it, and luckily it paid off here. [On his 94-run partnership with Ryan Burl] Yeah, it's something that I've been working on really hard, and it's come on leaps and bounds in the last six months or so. I'm really proud of my progress with the bat, and I just want to keep contributing in every area.
